limitations.description: Release artifacts provide SHA-256 checksums and provenance, but no cryptographic signature; Sigstore signing is deferred until a documented verification command exists.
FinishUP provides the foreground 'finishup service run' entrypoint for a user-selected external supervisor; native launchd and systemd-user installer commands are deferred.

Startup safety validation, 'finishup version --json', 'finishup service diagnostics' (one durable owner-only diagnostic record by correlation id), and the terminal interface's read-only '/doctor' report are available; a standalone public 'finishup doctor' CLI command and support-bundle schema remain deferred.

On Linux v0.1, approved external-command checks fail closed because the bubblewrap launch profile is not release-certified. Ledger operations and FinishUP's built-in deterministic checks remain available; no external command is reported as checked when the sandbox cannot enforce its boundary.

The E-001 through E-017 decision ledger in docs/OPEN_QUESTIONS.md remains an owner-reviewed release record; this evidence bundle does not claim that every ledger item is automatically represented or enforced.
